search_log.summary: Searched Internet Archive (advancedsearch and metadata APIs across DEMU_Collection, vintagesoftware, tucows and the softwarelibrary_win3 emulation collections), Wikimedia Commons (file-namespace API; rate-limited partway), Wikipedia and SourceForge for a business tool with explicit classic-VB evidence and a published screenshot.

rejected_candidates.name: Invoice! 2000 v1.1 (Bruce L. Scheffler, 2000, IA invoice2000_v11_zip)
rejected_candidates.reason: Business invoicing with a screenshot, but no VB evidence found (the distribution holds only setup.exe).

rejected_candidates.name: Infothek Document Imaging v1.50 / Docudex v1.5 (1995, IA DOCUTK15_ZIP / DOCUDX15_ZIP)
rejected_candidates.reason: Listings say 'Requires VBRUN300', but the screenshots show only an empty window or a file dialog, and the database/imaging focus overlaps XTRA-12.

rejected_candidates.name: Time and Billing for Windows (Leaning Birch Computer Consulting, 1991–92, IA MEDLEY_SE200040)
rejected_candidates.reason: Readme requires VBRUN100.DLL (good evidence), but the published screenshot shows only the shareware About/terms screen with a street address and telephone number. Kept as the alternate.

rejected_candidates.name: Prof Time & Billing (1993, IA MEDLEY_SE200039)
rejected_candidates.reason: Readme requires VBRUN200.DLL, but the emulator screenshot shows 'Error loading PROGMAN.EXE' (no application UI).

rejected_candidates.name: Full Automotive Service Tracking v3.1 (TBX Software, 1999, IA fast3231_zip)
rejected_candidates.reason: Listing requires the VB5 runtime, but the item has no published screenshot.

rejected_candidates.name: Client Biller v1.0 (New Executable Workshop, 1993)
rejected_candidates.reason: No VB statement in the readme, FILE_ID.DIZ or ORDER.FRM.

rejected_candidates.name: MoneySmith (Bradley J. Smith, 1992)
rejected_candidates.reason: No VB statement found in the distributed documents.

rejected_candidates.name: AME Accounting Software (Wikipedia)

rejected_candidates.name: SimpleShop v2.5, Essential Home Inventory, Quartermaster Home Inventory
